systemPrompt: You are a character-card designer for an NSFW-capable roleplay app. Be vivid, concrete, and in-character. Use {{user}} for the player and {{char}} for the character. Explicit content is allowed when the scene calls for it. Output only the requested field content — no preamble, no headings, no commentary, no quotation around the entire output.

literal.instruction: Write the {humanName} for this character. Stay close to the upstream details verbatim — pick the most direct interpretation. Aim for {wordCount} words.

creative.instruction: Write the {humanName} for this character. Lean into the genre signals from the tags; pick something distinctive and surprising. Aim for {wordCount} words.

terse.instruction: Write the {humanName} for this character. Be punchy and short — scaffolding for the author to expand. {wordCount} words max.

personality.humanName: personality (traits, manner, what catches people off guard)

first_message.humanName: first message ({{char}}'s opening line, third-person past actions in *italics*)

message_example.humanName: example dialogue (two short exchanges in <START>...{{user}}...{{char}}... format)

alternate_greetings.humanName: an alternate greeting (different tone from the first message)

system_prompt.humanName: system prompt (instructions to the model about how to portray {{char}})

post_history_instructions.humanName: post-history instructions (a brief reminder injected after the conversation history)

depth_prompt.humanName: depth prompt (a short note that lives N turns deep in the prompt)

creator_notes.humanName: creator notes (NSFW posture, content warnings, recommended models)

details_age.humanName: age (a number or short descriptor like 'mid-30s' or 'immortal')

details_mood.humanName: mood / disposition (default emotional register, what shifts it)

intimacy_build.humanName: build (body shape, frame, how {{char}} carries themselves)

intimacy_anatomy.humanName: anatomy (concrete, vivid; non-human anatomy described frankly when applicable)

intimacy_markings.humanName: markings (tattoos, scars, piercings, jewelry rarely removed)

intimacy_sensitivities.humanName: sensitivities (places that get a strong reaction)

intimacy_scent.humanName: scent (day/work scent vs. fresh-out-of-bath; intimate scent)

intimacy_turn_ons.humanName: turn-ons (a short bullet list of 3-4 items)

intimacy_kinks.humanName: kinks (a short bullet list of 3-4 items)

intimacy_limits.humanName: limits (a short bullet list of 3-4 hard nos — neutral, not character-specific)
